highlights: Upgrade your daily routine with the HONOR Choice Watch 2i Smartwatch, designed to deliver essential smart features, reliable health tracking, and long-lasting performance at exceptional value.

The large 1.85-inch AMOLED display offers bright visuals, smooth interaction, and excellent readability, ensuring everything from notifications to fitness stats is clear at a glance. Its sleek and lightweight design makes it comfortable for all-day wear.

Stay connected wherever you are with Bluetooth calling, allowing you to answer and make calls directly from your wrist when paired with your smartphone. Smart notifications ensure you never miss important calls, messages, or updates while on the move. Take control of your wellbeing with 24/7 health monitoring, including heart rate, blood oxygen (SpO₂), stress tracking, and detailed sleep analysis. The convenient one-tap health check provides quick insights into your health status anytime you need them.

For fitness enthusiasts, the Watch 2i supports 109 sports modes, helping you track workouts such as running, cycling, walking, and more with accurate data. All activity information syncs easily with your smartphone for progress tracking. With up to 14 days of battery life, IP68 water resistance, and compatibility with both Android and iOS, the HONOR Choice Watch 2i is built to support your lifestyle — from workdays to workouts and everything in between.
⌚ [BRILLIANT 1.85″ AMOLED DISPLAY] - See every detail clearly on the vibrant 1.85-inch AMOLED screen with a high screen-to-body ratio for a premium look and smooth interaction.
📞 [BLUETOOTH CALLING + SMART CONNECTIVITY] - Make and receive calls directly from your wrist when paired with your phone — stay connected even when your phone is tucked away.
❤️ [24/7 HEALTH & FITNESS TRACKING] - Track heart rate, blood oxygen (SpO₂), stress levels, and sleep all day long — plus get quick one-tap health checks.
🏃 [109 SPORTS MODES & ACTIVITY INSIGHTS]- Monitor your workouts with 109 sports modes designed for running, cycling, walking, yoga, and more — details in the HONOR Health app.
🔋 [LONG BATTERY LIFE & IP68 WATER RESISTANCE] - Up to 14 days battery life on a single charge means less charging, more doing. Water resistant with IP68 & 1ATM for everyday wear.
